name: Atmos Pipeline Texas / North Side Loop
researcher_notes: Atmos Energy and Energy Transfer Partners announced a letter of intent in December 2005 for a 45 mile, 30 inch intrastate line from Atmos Line W near Justin to near Frisco, Texas, in service by end of 2006, 200,000 MMBtu/d initial. The Natural Gas Intelligence pieces (p=53016 and p=24465) are one wire story, so one origin. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects, Excel rows 360 (West Side, 22 mi, completed May 2005 per EIA) and 407 (East Side, 25 mi, completed October 2006), lists both halves as completed new 30 inch intrastate pipe by Atmos Energy Inc, 225 MMcf/d each, total 47 mi. Length staged as the EIA 47 mi total; the announcement said 45 mi. Capacity 225 MMcf/d is EIA's per-half figure for the same line, not additive. Start year 2006 uses the later (East Side) completion date. Ownership: the announcement named Energy Transfer Partners as a joint owner funding the initial capital, but EIA lists Atmos as operator and the final split was not found; only Atmos staged. Only the 5,700 mi parent system P0369 exists in GEM, so this is a new expansion-style row under the same pipeline name. Not verified against the Texas Railroad Commission T-4 permit. No route researched. Tier medium: one origin each for announcement and EIA, completion not confirmed by an operator source.
